candidates.why: FIELD_VECTOR (histories, RL, num_histories, 0) at 3713 expands to `_obj->histories = calloc(...)` (macro line 226) with no free of the prior value. The same field is freed in free.c:1282, and the top-level loop at in_json.c:4213 can dispatch "RevHistory" (4273-4274) more than once for a duplicate key, so the second entry overwrites the first allocation. This is a leak/overwrite rather than a true use-after-free, hence low confidence.
